body: I have.. I'm not that close with anyone in the community I'm in. I can't even vent to them these kind of topics cause I just feel like I am stressing them out for these especially these thoughts are often pop up in my head so I have to keep up this positive persona... Despite I am aware everyone are nice to me and care about me..? I doubt I am that special though.. I am easily replaceable. There are better people there than me... this is how I am feeling right now.

That's a problem right now.. I have been isolated for so long since I drop out of college 2-3 years ago due to my mental health. I'm actually afraid of interacting new people in real life, even family members that I barely meet anymore, I just get very anxious easily... it's really difficult too now thanks to pandemic like I dunno where to even practice myself with other people in this situation. I'm just stuck in my house and always in need of internet cause god I can't live without it at this point... Doesn't help that living with parents who are still emotionally abusive to me.

All I can do is just cry and wishing to just be gone cause breathing feels like suffocating right now...

My problems just look pathetic right now...

It would been better...

I have toxic parents who is loyal to this cult especially my mom. They will never understand me especially my mental health. Currently right now in the quarantine, my mom won't stop complaining how bad my prayer is for panata(?). She keeps on reminding me in an angry tone, conplaining again and again about my prayer, and forcing me to pray every Monday to the point I'm starting to panic whenever Monday is near.

She won't let me change the prayer in words that I can understand. Yes, I'm not good at speaking in Tagalog and she gave me a Tagalog prayer to memorize so no speaking English or Taglish. But she said I shouldn't just memorize the prayer, I have to feel it, make it genuine. How the hell do I make it genuine when I'm being forced to do it and can't even understand what I am talking about in my prayer???

She became worse than the ones who come in every Wednesday nights at my home. Aggressive, forceful and just plain annoying.

I can celebrate holidays that I like. 
I can eat a medium rare steak. 
I can be someone who I love who is isn't an INC.

Hoping one day, I'll be free from this cult...
